property_summary: For any callee address and calldata, C.forward propagates a failing low-level call by reverting (i.e., forward either completes successfully iff the callee.low-level call returns true); the mutant that drops the require will NOT revert when the callee call fails, so there exist inputs (a reverting callee) where the mutant continues while the reference reverts.
change_summary: Remove the require check so forward never reverts due to callee call success/failure (allows difference when original would revert).
